definition_english: An archaic or historical sense denoting physical breadth, width, or lateral extent of a landmass, structure, or spatial region.
definition_hindi: किसी भूभाग, संरचना अथवा स्थानिक क्षेत्र की भौतिक चौड़ाई या विस्तार का प्राचीन एवं ऐतिहासिक अर्थ।

etymology.root: lātitūdō (breadth, width) from lātus (broad, wide; Old Latin stlātus), PIE *stele- (to spread)
etymology.semantic_development: Directly preserves the original classical Latin spatial meaning of physical breadth or width, which subsequently specialized into geographical north-south extent (HAT-003-S1) and figurative leeway (HAT-003-S3).

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Attested in chat summary for the archaic physical breadth sense; primary source URLs not yet established
Attested in chat summary alongside चौड़ाई for archaic breadth/extent; primary source URLs not yet established

hindi.adjective_agreement: चौड़ाई governs feminine agreement (अधिक चौड़ाई); alternative विस्तार is masculine (पुल्लिंग) and governs masculine agreement (व्यापक विस्तार)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Archaic and historical (described as such in chat research; not verified against a dictionary)
usage_restrictions: Described as archaic; encountered primarily in classical geography, historical treatises, and early modern texts.
Must not be mistranslated as अक्षांश (geographic coordinate) or विवेकाधिकार / छूट (legal-administrative leeway) when the historical source denotes physical width.

linguistic_analysis.gender_asymmetry: The two Hindi equivalents split by grammatical gender: चौड़ाई is feminine (स्त्रीलिंग), whereas विस्तार is masculine (पुल्लिंग), requiring different modifier and verb agreement.
linguistic_analysis.etymological_link: This sense is the semantic bridge in English between Latin lātitūdō (width) and the specialized geographic coordinate sense (HAT-003-S1).

conceptual_analysis.core_concept: Physical lateral width or spatial breadth, directly reflecting the Latin root lātitūdō prior to modern coordinate and figurative specialization.
conceptual_analysis.historical_status: Noted in the chat research as an archaic physical breadth sense; not verified against a historical dictionary.
conceptual_analysis.neighbor_boundaries: Must be separated from terrestrial coordinate latitude (अक्षांश, HAT-003-S1) in early modern geographic texts where both physical breadth and angular coordinates may appear, as well as from figurative leeway (छूट/विवेकाधिकार, HAT-003-S3).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote physical spatial spread or extent in Hindi.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चौड़ाई (feminine) specifically measures transverse width or breadth (directly matching Latin lātitūdō contrasted with length), whereas विस्तार (masculine) denotes broader overall extent, expanse, or spread in any direction.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Partially interchangeable in historical prose; चौड़ाई is preferred when explicitly contrasted with length, while विस्तार fits broader areal or regional span.

proposed_terminology.justification: Standard Hindi words चौड़ाई and विस्तार already express physical breadth and extent; no new terminology is needed for this historical English sense.
